text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The New Year. Tap Dance City's voyage enters the uncharted waters of the Senior Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until now, it had been a somewhat restless,
wandering journey, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright you lot, it's prayer time!
Hurl your uncompromising wishes right at the gods!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can run in the debutant races
and make my debut this year!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
This year, I'm definitely running in a graded race.
And placing in the top five!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
"I passed my exam for my dream school!
Take that, Mom!"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
This year, I'm definitely gonna confess!
Or make him confess to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No one showed any weakness.
Now that they had secured a solid foothold, everyone was full of confidence.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The finale is on me! I already know what I want.
Now that we've secured our base, next is--

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Let's go, let's do this "overseas expedition" in flashy style!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'll become the best in the world,
and turn our base into a castle!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oooooh.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
An overseas campaign...
It's finally happening...

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text: Is that really something we can aim for, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is a mountain of preparation to be done.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering Tap Dance City's current skill and growth,
going overseas is no longer just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, we returned to base.

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Haaan, it's so warmmm♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! It makes the freezing cold
we felt up until last year seem like a lie!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Right~? I do love barbecues, but in the middle of a howling north wind? No way~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
"I really am grateful for this after all.
A place to shelter from the wind and rain, that is."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Now then, someone turn on the TV.
Let's just relax and watch something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I turned on the power. And with that, footage of other Umamusume's New Year celebrations began to play.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, these guys are…… the Mejiro family, huh.
As expected of the biggest family.
Rolling in it right from New Year's."

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Over here is the Symboli family. It's not flashy,
but it has this sort of crisp, dignified feel to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems every household is having a fulfilling New Year.
Last year, I could only look upon such scenes with envy, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, this year,
we don't have to feel jealous at all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We might not have much money, but we've got
a home! And we've got family!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to family bonds, we're evenly matched!
Right, guys?

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Ooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as long as there's a place and bonds, you're family.
Even if the ones gathered here
are complete strangers...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They were now, in every sense, a true "Tap Dance City family."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Since we're ringing in the New Year
in a cabin-style base like this...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should play some pirate-y games.
Got a party game that fits the bill,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A pirate-themed party game.
The first one that comes to mind is..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A splish-splash drifting game?
Are we pretending to be shipwrecked or something?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that happens in movies too.
Yeah, that kind of thing happens in movies, too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You mean one of those "Day X of being stranded..." things?
Alright, let's give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I haven't had a bite to eat or a sip to drink
in 10 days... Water... Someone, please, water..."

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
Here, Tap, take this...
Cola, orange, or soda—which one do you want?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
And should I throw in some sweets and a banana too...?
There's mochi and stuff as well, though...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thanks...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't just casually serve food from the base.
If we have this much...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"This is paradise!
All you do is eat and sleep, eat and sleep...
It's straight-up heaven!"

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's one way to look at it.
Tap, want some potato chips too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A rather laid-back pretend castaway game.
We spent New Year's just lazily lounging around together.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A thrilling game of chance...?
Ah, that one. Where you stick someone in a barrel and stab swords into it, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay!
Someone bring over a barrel, then.
The one going in is obviously—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, how is it, Sir Navigator?
Or rather, Sir Prisoner!
How's it feel being unable to move?
choice_data_list: Me?! Wait, what's with that sword...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, borrowed it from the island's hero.
Guess you could call it a stylish rental."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That said, it's just a toy, so don't worry.
Alright, here it comes—right into you!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: SEIYAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Swish)

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oooh.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Safe! See, no problem, right?
Have a little faith in me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep blastin' through like this!
Consecutive skewers! SEIYAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yee-haw! All safe!
Alright then, into this very last hole...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Tap Dance City.
Focusing every single nerve, she managed to
avoid the one and only winning hole.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A BangBang naval battle game, huh?
Well, since we've got ourselves a ship, let's go blast 'em to pieces!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to text the other Umamusume
and ask, 'Wanna play Battleship?!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the online naval battle game began.
The one who came on the attack was—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Tap! Vessel approaching!
That's—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text: It's the latest-model Silent Americana!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Silent Americana...
Which means the one riding it is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
B... B... B... Neo Universe has
'found' it. The enemy ship's 'SHAD.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The attack commander is... Rob Roy, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to me, Uni-san!
Ready, aim!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“The sci-fi Umamusume, Neo Universe,
and Zenno Rob Roy, who yearns to be a hero.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous Cannon, all prepped to fire☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday, as marvelous as ever.
With the mysterious main cannon primed and ready—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
3, 2, 1, 0!
Marvelous Cannon, fire!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus☆★♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*BOOOM*☆★♪)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Direct hit on our flank! Emergency! It breached the hull,
and a massive amount of Marvelous is flooding the ship!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Darn it! Not bad.
Alright, time for a counterattack!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And with that, we enjoyed the naval battle game.
Playing with such enthusiasm put me in
a truly MARVELOUS☆ mood.
